windows_companion.instructions: On real supported Windows: installed AeroScience launches from Start and automatically opens its dashboard, without a terminal/server command.

offline_archive_export.instructions: With MSFS closed: the selected local archive and saved mission details/export are accessible; existing history remains intact.

toolbar_install_load.instructions: With MSFS closed: graphical Settings installs the included genuine SDK package; after starting MSFS its toolbar opens.

simconnect_live.instructions: In MSFS: the loaded aircraft and fresh actual SimConnect telemetry appear; no generated data is substituted.

live_mission_smoke.instructions: Start and end a short actual flight mission, inspect its recorded samples and confirm retained history after restarting AeroScience.

runtime_dependencies.instructions: On real Windows: included licensed native runtime loads with required exports; supported graphical Visual C++ prerequisites work without SDK/manual DLL copying.

release_contents.instructions: Verify the exact candidate installer checksum and installed files against its receipt; inspect that package/runtime are complete and no personal data is included.

installer_install.instructions: Run this exact setup EXE on Windows: branding/path/progress, bundled prerequisites, Start shortcut, optional desktop shortcut, Installed Apps registration and launch-at-finish work. Test a clean Windows account/environment without developer tools.

setup_wizard.instructions: Test graphical first-run storage paths on separate drives, capacity/warning, Community detection/browse/confirmation, MSFS-running guard, toolbar installation and Skip for Now. Settings can revisit both.

upgrade_preservation.instructions: Install over an existing application. Confirm existing settings, both storage paths, mission IDs/modes/samples and library files survive; requested changes use verified migrations and keep originals.

uninstall_preservation.instructions: Use Windows Installed Apps to uninstall. Confirm app/shortcuts are removed, data/configuration remain, and keeping or explicitly removing the toolbar works with unrelated add-ons preserved. Reinstall and confirm archive access.
